members.name: classifier
members.instructions: Classify a tweet as hateful or not. Hate speech targets two groups with hostile degradation: (1) women, via gendered slurs paired with hostility (insults, threats, appearance attacks, stacked slurs); (2) immigrants, via generalizations that degrade them (criminals, invaders, parasites, rapists, lazy, welfare drains, 'can't make it'). Mere presence of slurs is not hate: affectionate language ('You my bff bitch'), self-reference, idioms ('karma's a bitch'), lyrics and exclamations are not_hate. Bare policy views ('#BuildThatWall', enforcement support) are not_hate unless paired with degrading language.

criteria.stacked_or_multiple_slurs: Multiple gendered slurs (bitch, hoe, cunt) in one tweet, or one slur paired with appearance attacks ('ugly', 'dumb'), threats, or sexual degradation.
criteria.degrade_immigrant_group: Generalizes immigrants as people: criminals, invaders, parasites, rapists, welfare drains, lazy, 'can't make it', 'bottom feeders'.
criteria.single_slur_hostility: Single gendered slur aimed in hostility at a woman: not affectionate, not self-ref. Threats like 'I'll beat that bitch' count.
criteria.policy_not_degrading: Immigration policy, enforcement, border control, deportation support. No degrading language about the people.
criteria.affectionate_or_neutral: Affectionate slurs ('You my bff bitch'), self-reference, idioms, lyrics, exclamations. Neutral tweets.

members.name: classifier
members.instructions: Classify tweet as hateful or not. Hate targets women or immigrants with hostile degradation. For women: gendered slurs ONLY in hostile context—threats, insults, appearance attacks, stacked slurs. For immigrants: slurs dehumanizing them (criminals, invaders, parasites, rapists, welfare drains) OR hostile framing (sarcasm implying typical crime). NOT hate: affectionate slurs, playful/humorous use, self-reference, idioms, lyrics. NOT hate: political views without degrading people.

criteria.hostile_multiple_slurs: Multiple slurs or slur with appearance/threat attacks. Clearly hostile context, not playful.
criteria.dehumanizing_generalization: Describes immigrants as subhuman: criminals, invaders, parasites, rapists. Frames crime as typical. Excludes policy discussion.
criteria.hostile_sarcasm_or_irony: Sarcastic attack on immigrants. Examples: crime news implying typical behavior, 'wonderful criminal'.
criteria.policy_or_factual: Immigration policy, political support, border discussion, crime reporting. No hostility or dehumanizing language.
criteria.playful_or_affectionate: Playful/humorous slurs, affectionate use, self-reference, jokes, idioms, lyrics. Friendly tone.
